comment: Professor McKechnie is great at what he does. I've taken him 3 times (Business Law and Legal Research and Writing 1 & II) and I got A's in all 3 classes. As long as you do the work and try you'll pass.

Prof Mckechnie lets you have quizzes open book but be prepared to still get a C. The way he words his quizzes makes it impossible for you to pass. We had to do 2-3 case studies every week which wasn't bad, but don't expect help. He's also SUCH a hard ass he thinks he's a Harvard Law School professor
